title: NimbusLex AI Labs
text:
NimbusLex AI Labs

["Lead origin: inbound form (tech blog post). ML Eng (Samir Rao) initial request: 'we need embeddings + fast reranking for legal search',", '2025-11-12: Intro call with AE Jordan + SE Priya. Product fit good, wants VPC + SOC2. (ff_20251112_01)', '2026-01-18: Sent security questionnaire (drive:/security/nimbuslex-security-qa-2026-01.xlsx). Security = primary blocker, asked for evidence of key management + audit logs.', '2026-02-03: POC kickoff with SE, agreed 2-week pilot to validate latency on 2M-doc index. Notes: prioritise prefix caching, batch config. (ff_20260203_01)', '2026-02-10: AE sent PoC SOW + estimated pricing, asked for signature to begin. No reply after this email (gt_4d5e6f_poc_notes).', '2026-02-18: Follow-up call attempt -> voicemail left. 2026-02-21: follow-up email + InMail, no response.', "2026-02-28: Internal signal from champion Samir: hiring freeze + procurement pause. Quote from Samir: 'we're pausing all pilots for Q2 — sorry, no ETA'.", 'Sales status: stalled/ghosted post-intro. AE recommended nurture cadence; SE flagged security escalation if they re-engage.', "Risk: likely closed-lost to budget freeze or competitor pilot with OpenAI; security had asked about on-prem package and ISO which we can't meet in short term.", "Suggested playbook: send short 'we're here when ready' note, include security FAQ + lightweight hosted alternative (dedicated with VPC) to try to keep door open.", "Next action owner: Jordan. 'If no reply by 2026-03-25, close with reason: budget_freeze / no_champion'"]
